# Amsterdam Pop-ups

> A weekly, map-first guide to temporary, pop-up and one-off events in Amsterdam: food, art, family and culture. Every event is checked on the organiser's own page before it is listed. English and Dutch.

The guide is edited by hand and updated every week (Monday to Sunday). Each listing has a date, time, venue address, price and a link to the organiser's page. Past weeks stay in the Archive on the main site.

## This week (16 – 22 Nov, 94 events)

- [This week's events as a plain list](https://www.amsterdampopups.com/this-week.html): every event with date, time, venue, price, organiser, description and link; readable without JavaScript
- [Interactive guide](https://www.amsterdampopups.com/): map, category and day filters, English/Dutch toggle, archive

## Categories

- Food (NL: Eten)
- Drink (NL: Drinken)
- Markets (NL: Markten)
- Christmas Markets (NL: Kerstmarkten)
- Sinterklaas (NL: Sinterklaas)
- Fashion & Vintage (NL: Mode & Vintage)
- Art & Design (NL: Kunst & Design)
- Pop-up Shops (NL: Pop-upwinkels)
- Music (NL: Muziek)
- Nightlife (NL: Nachtleven)
- Film (NL: Film)
- Kids & Family (NL: Gezin & Kids)
- Sport (NL: Sport)
- Active & Outdoor (NL: Actief & Buiten)
- Theatre & Dance (NL: Theater & Dans)
- Comedy (NL: Comedy/Cabaret)
- Workshops (NL: Workshops)
- Queer (NL: Queer)
- Business (NL: Zakelijk)
- Networking (NL: Netwerken)

Events can belong to several categories. "Regular" marks weekly or recurring series; everything else is a one-off or limited run.
